title: Quantum oscillator
tagline: A probability wave in a parabolic well: combine states and watch quantum mechanics ring.

potential.title: Potential V(x) = ½x²
potential.desc: The same spring as the classical oscillator, now as an energy well. A classical particle with energy E would bounce between the points where the parabola meets the E line.

packet.title: Wave function
packet.desc: Its height is |ψ(x)| and its color the phase (arg ψ); with the |ψ|² chip you see the probability of finding the particle at x. Drag it to make a coherent state somewhere else; fling it to give it momentum.

velocity.title: Momentum ⟨p⟩
velocity.desc: The packet's mean momentum. While paused, drag its tip to choose ⟨p⟩(0).

level0.title: Level n = 0
level0.desc: The eigenstate ψ₀, with energy E₀ = 0.5 ħω and 0 nodes. On its own it is stationary: |ψ|² never changes. Its sliders set how much of it is in the superposition, and with which phase.

wheel0.title: Phasor c₀
wheel0.desc: The coefficient c₀ in the complex plane: its length is |c₀| and its angle the phase. It turns clockwise at angular speed E₀ = 0.5 ω. Drag inside the wheel to change it; the others rescale so the total probability stays 1.

presetInfo.ground: The lowest energy state, E₀ = ½ ħω: even at rest the particle never stands still (zero-point energy). It is stationary: the color turns but |ψ| never changes.
presetInfo.first: The first excited state: a node in the middle, where the particle is never found. The phase on the left and on the right is opposite (complementary colors).
presetInfo.slosh: Half ψ₀, half ψ₁. Their phases turn at different speeds (½ and 3/2), so they interfere back and forth: the density sloshes from side to side with period 2π.
presetInfo.correspondence: n = 10 with the classical density dotted: a classical particle spends most of its time near the turning points, and |ψ|² wiggles around that curve. The larger n, the closer they get (correspondence principle).
presetInfo.coherent: A coherent state |α⟩: a minimum-uncertainty Gaussian packet (Δx·Δp = ½) that oscillates exactly like the classical block, without changing shape.
presetInfo.cat: Schrödinger cat: |α⟩ + |−α⟩, the packet on the left and on the right at once. When the two halves cross in the middle, interference fringes appear.
presetInfo.revival: A mix of ψ₀, ψ₂ and ψ₅ with different phases. It looks messy, but at t = 2π everything starts over exactly: watch the carpet repeat.
